sources.title: Model Distillation: The Key to Efficient AI Deployment
sources.snippet: The smaller models democraticize AI use cases in edge computing devices, smartphones, etc. Distillation of a large model into a small model also retains most of the knowledge of the larger model, so the performance-to-size tradeoff is worth it.

sources.title: GitHub - horus-ai-labs/DistillFlow: Library for model distillation
sources.snippet: DistillFlow is an open-source toolkit designed to simplify and scale the distillation of large language models (LLMs) into smaller, more efficient models. It provides a flexible pipeline for distillation, fine-tuning, and experimentation across multiple GPUs, with support for dynamic resource allocation and easy integration of custom techniques.
